explanation: The signed renewal order form (effective 2026-02-01) set Tansley Parcel at 120 seats, and that term ran through 2027-01-31, so it covered March 2026. Lev Arkadin's 2026-03-03 email claiming 125 seats was only a true-up request, not a contract change, and the CRM note says the true-up is expected at renewal.
